name: Experiential production
meta: Experiential production in New York City: interactive installations, immersive projection, fabrication and the AV to run them, built in Brooklyn.
h1: Experiential production in NYC, built in Brooklyn.
sub: Interactive installations, immersive projection, pop-up builds and the technology behind them, for brands, museums and events across New York. Designed, built and tested in Brooklyn, then installed and run by our crew.
images: An interactive exhibit in a gallery

items: Floors, walls and screens built in TouchDesigner, with sensors and body tracking
Projection mapping and spatial audio across whole spaces
Sets, pop-up units, props and large-format 3D printing
Installed, tested and run on site by our crew
A hero piece people walk up to, photograph and share.
Units and windows that arrive finished, with the tech built in.
Immersive and interactive pieces that run every day.
A moment in the program that people remember.
Midtown offices, hotel ballrooms, SoHo storefronts, galleries and rooftops.
Warehouses, studios and lofts in Brooklyn and Long Island City, minutes from where the gear is packed.
Schools, campuses, parks and public spaces across the other boroughs, and Jersey City and Long Island too.
Building the physical experience: the interactive pieces, the set, the projection and sound, and the crew that installs and runs it.
Do you design the experience or build what an agency designed?
Both. Some projects come with creative direction from an agency or studio; on others we take it from the first sketch.
Can people interact with the piece?
Yes. We build interactive floors, walls and screens with sensors, body tracking and RFID or NFC triggers.
Can it be tested before the event?
Yes. Pieces are built and tested in Brooklyn before they are installed.
Yes. The same build and crew can go to several cities. See touring.

quote.h: Start with what you need and when.
quote.lead: Tell us where, when, how many people and what has to happen. We reply with one quote for equipment, crew and delivery.
